#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> polynomialMultiply(const vector<int>& A, const vector<int>& B, int mod) {
    int M = A.size() + B.size() - 1;
    int size = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(M - 1)));
    
    vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < A.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)A[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    
    vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < B.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)B[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        br[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        bi[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    
    // Perform FFT on A and B
    vector<double> cr(size, 0.0), ci(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> dr(size, 0.0), di(size, 0.0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double A1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
        double A1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double A2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double A2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;
        
        double B1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
        double B1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double B2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double B2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;
        
        cr[i] = A1r * B1r - A1i * B1i - A2r * B2i - A2i * B2r;
        ci[i] = A1r * B1i + A1i * B1r + A2r * B2r - A2i * B2i;
        dr[i] = A1r * B2r - A1i * B2i + A2r * B1r - A2i * B1i;
        di[i] = A1r * B2i + A1i * B2r + A2r * B1i + A2i * B1r;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT
    for (int len = 2; len <= size; len <<= 1) {
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len;
        double wlen_re = cos(angle);
        double wlen_im = sin(angle);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += len) {
            double w_re = 1.0;
            double w_im = 0.0;
            int half = len >> 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double ur = cr[i + j];
                double ui = ci[i + j];
                double vr = cr[i + j + half] * w_re - ci[i + j + half] * w_im;
                double vi = cr[i + j + half] * w_im + ci[i + j + half] * w_re;
                
                cr[i + j] = ur + vr;
                ci[i + j] = ui + vi;
                cr[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                ci[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
                
                double tmp = w_re * wlen_re - w_im * wlen_im;
                w_im = w_re * wlen_im + w_im * wlen_re;
                w_re = tmp;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= size; len <<= 1) {
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len;
        double wlen_re = cos(angle);
        double wlen_im = sin(angle);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += len) {
            double w_re = 1.0;
            double w_im = 0.0;
            int half = len >> 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double ur = dr[i + j];
                double ui = di[i + j];
                double vr = dr[i + j + half] * w_re - di[i + j + half] * w_im;
                double vi = dr[i + j + half] * w_im + di[i + j + half] * w_re;
                
                dr[i + j] = ur + vr;
                di[i + j] = ui + vi;
                dr[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                di[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
                
                double tmp = w_re * wlen_re - w_im * wlen_im;
                w_im = w_re * wlen_im + w_im * wlen_re;
                w_re = tmp;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        cr[i] /= size;
        ci[i] /= size;
        dr[i] /= size;
        di[i] /= size;
    }
    
    vector<int> result(M);
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        long long A_part = llround(cr[i]);
        long long B_part = llround(dr[i]);
        long long C_part = llround(ci[i]);
        result[i] = (int)((A_part + ((B_part % mod) << 15) + ((C_part % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

void performFFT(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        for (; (j ^= bit) < bit; bit >>= 1);
        if (i < j) {
            swap(re[i], re[j]);
            swap(im[i], im[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        double wlen_re = cos(angle);
        double wlen_im = sin(angle);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double w_re = 1.0;
            double w_im = 0.0;
            int half = len >> 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double ur = re[i + j];
                double ui = im[i + j];
                double vr = re[i + j + half] * w_re - im[i + j + half] * w_im;
                double vi = re[i + j + half] * w_im + im[i + j + half] * w_re;
                
                re[i + j] = ur + vr;
                im[i + j] = ui + vi;
                re[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                im[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
                
                double tmp = w_re * wlen_re - w_im * wlen_im;
                w_im = w_re * wlen_im + w_im * wlen_re;
                w_re = tmp;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> coeffs(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        coeffs[x] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> resPoly = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            resPoly = polynomialMultiply(resPoly, coeffs, MOD);
        }
        coeffs = polynomialMultiply(coeffs, coeffs, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int val : resPoly) {
        ans = (ans + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
